title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium Arena on 1982-12-30

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1982 show with a smoking Throwing Stones → Franklin’s Tower transition, early Touch, and stellar guest Tower of Power horns.
ai_review.review: The recording is crystal‑clear and well balanced – vocals, bass, guitar, keys and drums sit perfectly together, with only a brief horn mic delay at the start. Musically the concert is fire‑hot: tight set‑list flow, an iconic Throwing Stones into Franklin’s Tower segue, early versions of Touch, a standout Saint of Circumstance, and guest horns on Hard To Handle and Tell Mama, all driven by Jerry’s fiery playing and Phil’s thumping bass.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (average 4.5) with enthusiastic comments on both performance and sound quality across ten reviews.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, balanced mix; vocals, bass, guitar, keys and drums are perfectly level. Minor early‑set horn mic delay but overall clear and listenable.

standout_songs: Hard To Handle (with Tower of Power)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets praised; tight transitions especially Throwing Stones into Franklin's Tower, with an unusual first‑set song placement that keeps momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly described as on fire, with perfect tone and whisper‑like notes during Sailor; drives the jam when Bobby’s string breaks.
band_member_comments.Phil: “Phil is on!” – thumping bass that jumps out in the mix from the start.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby (Bob Weir) delivers strong vocal improvisations; his broken string moment adds stage drama.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s solo highlighted and Billy’s tambourine dance behind him noted as a fun moment.
